name: HeeChan "heegong123" Kim
biography: HeeChan Kim is a security researcher and a student at Soongsil University, specializing in Windows OS internals and Local Privilege Escalation (LPE). As a winner of the DEF CON 33 CTF with team MMM and a member of TeamH4C, he actively hunts for zero-days and persistent logical flaws within complex OS architectures. He has previously presented his Windows LPE research at POC and RE//verse.
